title: 第025章 坦言交易各所需第026章 惊鸿剑谱诱人心
lines: 银针落下，如雨如织。秦夜的手，稳如磐石，快如闪电。每一针的深浅、角度、捻转的力道，甚至刺入的时机，都经过精确的计算和控制。他的神情专注到极致，眼中倒映着银针的寒芒和那女子体表若隐若现的淡蓝色冰裂纹路。
这一次施针，与救治阿萝时截然不同。阿萝的伤，主要是外力硬伤和感染，虽有经脉损伤，但根基未损。而这白衣女子，却是内伤、剑气反噬、阴寒侵脉交织在一起的复杂绝症，如同在满是裂缝、又结了冰的琉璃瓶里灭火，稍有不慎，便是瓶碎人亡。
秦夜将《九转生死诀》的真气运转到极致，那一缕微弱却精纯无比、带着一丝逆转生死特性的真气，顺着银针，丝丝缕缕地渗入女子体内。真气所过之处，既要疏导狂暴乱窜的剑气，又要抵御、化解那阴寒刺骨的毒力，还要小心翼翼地修复受损的经脉，刺激她几乎熄灭的生机。
这过程不仅极度消耗真气，更对神识是巨大的考验。秦夜的额头上很快布满了细密的汗珠，脸色也微微发白。但他眼神依旧清明，动作没有丝毫变形。
时间在令人窒息的专注中流逝。房间内，只有银针微颤的“嗡嗡”声，和女子偶尔因为剧痛而发出的、极其轻微的闷哼。
守在门外的阿萝，紧张得手心全是汗，紧紧攥着拐杖，眼睛一眨不眨地盯着房门，仿佛能透过木板看到里面的情形。楼下隐约传来掌柜和伙计压抑的哭泣和收拾尸体的声音，更添了几分不安。
约莫过了一炷香的功夫，秦夜终于停下了手。
床上，白衣女子体表那些淡蓝色的冰裂纹路，蔓延的速度明显减缓，颜色也黯淡了些许。她脸上那不正常的死灰色，稍稍退去了一点，呼吸虽然依旧微弱，但不再像之前那样断断续续，有了一丝规律。最明显的变化是，她身上散发出的那股阴寒锋锐、令人不适的气息，被一股温和却坚韧的暖流所取代，虽然依旧虚弱，但至少不再继续恶化。
秦夜长长地舒了一口气，身体晃了晃，连忙扶住床沿才站稳。他感到一阵强烈的虚脱感，体内真气几乎消耗殆尽，太阳穴隐隐作痛。这次施针的消耗，远超之前任何一次。
他强打精神，将女子身上的银针逐一取下。银针尖端，有些凝结了淡淡的冰晶，有些则仿佛被某种锋锐气息侵蚀，光泽黯淡。他将这些废针收起，又从怀中取出一个小玉瓶，倒出一颗用血参和其他药材炼制的、固本培元的药丸，捏开女子的嘴，喂了进去，又给她灌了点温水。
做完这些，秦夜才走到桌边坐下，倒了一杯冷水，慢慢喝着，恢复体力。目光落在床上昏迷的女子身上，眼神复杂。
救活了。暂时。
但这女子的伤势，远未痊愈。那股阴寒的毒力（或特殊劲气）只是被暂时压制、隔绝，并未根除。她自身暴走的剑气，也只是被引导梳理，回归了部分正轨。内腑的损伤，经脉的淤塞，都需要长时间的药物调理和自身修养。更重要的是，她必须停止强行催动那超越自身负荷的剑法，否则反噬会一次比一次严重。
“秦大哥，她……怎么样了？”阿萝听到里面没了动静，小声地在门外问道。
“暂时稳住了，死不了。”秦夜的声音带着疲惫，“你进来吧，把门关好。”
阿萝连忙推门进来，看到秦夜苍白的脸色，吓了一跳：“秦大哥，你……”
“我没事，消耗大了点。”秦夜摆摆手，示意无妨。他看了一眼床上依旧昏迷的女子，对阿萝道：“给她擦一下脸和手，换身干净的衣服。用我的衣服，你的太小。小心点，别碰到她的伤口，尤其是右手。”
阿萝点点头，虽然心里有些莫名的紧张和说不清道不明的情绪，但还是立刻去打水，找出秦夜包袱里一件相对干净的里衣，小心地给那女子擦拭脸上、手上的血污，又费力地帮她换下那身染血的白衣。触手处一片冰凉，让阿萝忍不住打了个寒颤。这女子容貌极美，即使昏迷中，也自有一股清冷孤高的气质，让阿萝不禁有些自惭形秽，但更多的是好奇。
换好衣服，阿萝将染血的白衣和秦夜换下的外衣一起拿到楼下，让吓得半死的掌柜婆娘去浆洗。又吩咐准备了热水和简单的粥食端上来。
秦夜调息了约莫半个时辰，真气恢复了小半，精神也好了一些。他走到床边，再次检查女子的脉象。脉象虽然依旧虚弱紊乱，但比起之前那种油尽灯枯、寒毒肆虐的绝境，已经好了太多，至少有了回转的余地。
“应该快醒了。”秦夜低语。这女子意志极为坚韧，求生欲也强，加上他的针法和药物，清醒只是时间问题。
果然，又过了一盏茶功夫，床上女子的睫毛微微颤动了一下，随即，那双寒潭秋水般的眸子，缓缓睁开。
起初，眼神有些涣散和茫然，但很快便聚焦，恢复了那种冰冷锐利的清明。她看到了站在床边的秦夜，眼神瞬间一凝，下意识地就想坐起，但身体刚一动，便牵动了伤势，闷哼一声，眉头紧蹙，额头上渗出冷汗。
“别乱动。”秦夜平静开口，“你的伤势我只是暂时稳住，乱动会再次引发剑气反噬和寒毒扩散。”
女子闻言，动作停住，但眼神依旧冰冷警惕，如同蓄势待发的雌豹，扫视着秦夜，又看了看旁边的阿萝，以及这间简陋的客房。她似乎在快速回忆和判断当前的处境。
“是你……救了我？”她的声音很轻，带着重伤后的虚弱和沙哑，但语气中的清冷和疏离感不减。
“路过，顺手。”秦夜语气平淡，在桌边坐下，给自己倒了杯水，也示意阿萝坐下。“你在客栈门口杀了几个黑风寨的土匪，然后伤重倒地。我扶你进来，施针稳住了你的伤势。仅此而已。”
女子沉默了片刻，似乎是在感受体内的状况。她能感觉到，那股几乎要将她撕裂的阴寒毒力和暴走剑气，已经被一股温和却坚韧的力量暂时压制、隔绝，虽然伤势依旧沉重，但至少不再继续恶化，甚至有了微弱的修复迹象。这让她冰冷警惕的眼神中，闪过一丝难以置信的惊异。
她自己的伤势自己清楚，是强行施展“惊鸿一剑”透支本源，又被“寒冰掌”的阴毒掌力侵入心脉所致。这等伤势，寻常医师别说救治，恐怕连诊断都难。而这个看起来年纪不过十七八岁、修为似乎只有淬体一重的少年，竟然能在如此短的时间内，将她从鬼门关拉回来？
这绝不是普通医师能做到的！而且，他施针时，那股渗入自己体内的奇异真气，虽然微弱，却带着一种难以言喻的坚韧和……一丝令人心悸的、仿佛能逆转生死的特性！
“你……懂医术？师承何人？”女子看着秦夜，眼神中的警惕并未完全散去，但语气缓和了些许。
“略懂。至于师承，不便相告。”秦夜回答得很直接，看着女子，“你又是谁？为何被黑风寨追杀？你体内的阴寒毒力和那品阶不低的剑气，又是怎么回事？”
他没有拐弯抹角。救了人，自然要弄清楚救的是谁，会带来什么麻烦。这女子来历不明，实力不弱（全盛时期恐怕远超淬体境），又明显惹上了大麻烦，他必须心中有数。
女子迎上秦夜审视的目光，没有立刻回答。她在权衡。眼前这个少年救了她的命，但身份神秘，实力也透着一股诡异。是敌是友，尚难定论。但自己现在重伤在身，又身处黑风寨势力范围附近，似乎……没有太多选择的余地。
片刻，她似乎下定了决心，缓缓开口，声音依旧清冷：“我叫叶轻眉。来自……天风郡，落霞剑宗。”
天风郡？落霞剑宗？
秦夜在记忆中搜索。青云城属于天南郡，与天风郡相隔数千里，中间隔着大片山脉和荒野。落霞剑宗，他隐约有点印象，似乎是一个以剑道闻名的宗门，在天风郡算是二流势力中的佼佼者，比紫阳宗似乎还要强上一些。难怪这女子剑法如此凌厉，能催发剑气。
“至于被黑风寨追杀……”叶轻眉眼中闪过一丝冰冷的杀意和屈辱，“我奉师门之命，前往西南‘葬剑谷’附近寻找一味灵药‘赤阳朱果’。途经黑风岭时，被黑风寨三当家贺彪带人伏击。他们觊觎我身上的财物和……剑谱，我力战突围，斩杀数人，但也中了贺彪的‘寒冰掌’，伤势爆发，一路逃到这里。”
她顿了顿，看了一眼秦夜：“客栈门口那几人，是贺彪手下的斥候，刚从附近村镇劫掠回来，正好撞上。我本想杀了他们，稍泄心头之恨，却引得伤势彻底爆发。”
原来如此。秦夜心中了然。黑风寨果然嚣张，连路过宗门弟子都敢劫杀。贺彪的寒冰掌，看来就是那阴寒毒力的来源了。
“你体内的剑气反噬，又是怎么回事？”秦夜追问。那剑气品阶极高，恐怕不是落霞剑宗的普通传承。
叶轻眉沉默了一下，眼中闪过一丝复杂，但最终还是坦然道：“是我强行施展了宗门禁术‘惊鸿一剑’。此剑威力极大，但需以燃烧本源、透支潜力为代价。我修为不够，强行施展，导致剑气失控反噬，与寒毒交织，几乎要了我的命。”
content_en:
The silver needles fell like rain. Qin Ye's hand was as steady as a rock and as fast as lightning. The depth, angle, twisting force, and even the timing of each needle insertion are precisely calculated and controlled. His expression was extremely focused, and his eyes reflected the cold light of the silver needle and the looming light blue ice crack lines on the woman's body.
The acupuncture treatment this time was completely different from the time when treating A Luo. A Luo's injuries were mainly caused by external force and infection. Although there was damage to the meridians, the foundation was not damaged. But this woman in white suffered from a complex terminal disease that was intertwined with internal injuries, sword energy backlash, and coldness invading her veins. It was like putting out a fire in a glass bottle full of cracks and filled with ice. If you were not careful, the bottle would break and you would die.
Qin Ye used the "Nine Transformations of Life and Death Art"'s true energy to the extreme. The weak but extremely pure true energy, with a hint of the characteristics of reversing life and death, followed the silver needle and penetrated into the woman's body. Wherever the zhenqi passes, it must not only channel the violent sword energy, but also resist and neutralize the cold and biting poison. It must also carefully repair the damaged meridians and stimulate her almost extinguished vitality.
This process not only consumes the true energy extremely, but is also a huge test for the spiritual consciousness. Qin Ye's forehead was soon covered with beads of sweat, and his face turned slightly pale. But his eyes were still clear and his movements were not deformed at all.
Time passed in suffocating concentration. In the room, there was only the slight "buzzing" sound of the silver needle and the woman's occasional, extremely slight groan due to severe pain.
A Luo, who was guarding the door, was so nervous that her palms were all sweaty. She clutched her crutches tightly and stared at the door without blinking, as if she could see what was going on inside through the wooden boards. Downstairs, the suppressed crying of the shopkeeper and waiters and the sound of collecting corpses could be heard faintly, which added to the uneasiness.
After about a stick of incense, Qin Ye finally stopped.
On the bed, the light blue cracked ice lines on the body surface of the woman in white have slowed down significantly and their color has also dimmed a bit. The abnormal gray color on her face receded a little, and although her breathing was still weak, it was no longer as intermittent as before, and had a trace of regularity. The most obvious change was that the cold, sharp, and uncomfortable aura exuding from her body was replaced by a gentle but tough warmth. Although she was still weak, at least it no longer worsened.
Qin Ye let out a long sigh of relief, swayed, and quickly held on to the edge of the bed before standing still. He felt a strong sense of collapse, the energy in his body was almost exhausted, and there was a dull pain in his temples. The consumption of acupuncture this time was far greater than any previous one.
He steeled himself and removed the silver needles from the woman's body one by one. Some of the tips of the silver needles were condensed with light ice crystals, while others seemed to be eroded by some sharp aura, and their luster was dim. He put away these waste needles, took out a small jade bottle from his arms, poured out a pill made from blood ginseng and other medicinal materials to strengthen the body and strengthen the body. He opened the woman's mouth, fed it in, and poured some warm water into her.
After doing this, Qin Ye walked to the table and sat down. He poured a glass of cold water and drank it slowly to regain his strength. His eyes fell on the unconscious woman on the bed with complicated eyes.
Saved. temporary.
But the woman's injuries were far from healed. The cold poisonous power (or special energy) was only temporarily suppressed and isolated, but not eradicated. Her own violent sword energy was only guided and sorted out, and she returned to some parts of the right track. Damage to the internal organs and blockage of the meridians require long-term medication and self-cultivation. More importantly, she must stop forcing the sword technique beyond her own load, otherwise the backlash will become more serious each time.
"Brother Qin, how is she...?" A Luo asked quietly outside the door when she heard there was no movement inside.
"It's stable for the time being. I can't die." Qin Ye's voice was full of fatigue. "Come in and close the door."
A Luo quickly opened the door and came in. She was shocked when she saw Qin Ye's pale face: "Brother Qin, you..."
"I'm fine, it's a bit too much." Qin Ye waved his hand, indicating that it was okay. He glanced at the still unconscious woman on the bed and said to A Luo: "Wipe her face and hands, and change into clean clothes. Use my clothes, yours are too small. Be careful not to touch her wounds, especially her right hand."
A'luo nodded. Although she felt a little inexplicable nervousness and unexplainable emotions, she immediately went to fetch water and found a relatively clean inner garment in Qin Ye's bag. She carefully wiped the blood on the woman's face and hands, and then helped her change out of the blood-stained white garment. The tentacles were so cold that A Luo couldn't help but shiver. This woman was extremely beautiful, and even in a coma, she had a cold and aloof temperament, which made A Luo feel a little ashamed of herself, but she was more curious.
After changing her clothes, A'luo took the blood-stained white clothes downstairs together with Qin Ye's coat, and asked the shopkeeper's wife, who was scared to death, to wash them. He also ordered hot water and simple porridge to be prepared and served.
Qin Ye adjusted his breathing for about half an hour. He recovered half of his energy and felt better. He walked to the bed and checked the woman's pulse again. Although his pulse condition is still weak and disordered, it is much better than the previous desperate situation of running out of oil and running out of lamps and raging cold poison. At least there is room for improvement.
"Should wake up soon." Qin Ye whispered. This woman has an extremely strong will and a strong desire to survive. With his acupuncture and medicine, it is only a matter of time before she wakes up.
Sure enough, after another cup of tea, the eyelashes of the woman on the bed trembled slightly, and then, her eyes like autumn water in a cold pool slowly opened.
At first, his eyes were a little distracted and confused, but they soon focused and regained that cold, sharp clarity. She saw Qin Ye standing by the bed, her eyes froze for a moment, and she subconsciously wanted to sit up, but as soon as her body moved, her injury was affected. She groaned, frowned, and cold sweat broke out on her forehead.
"Don't move." Qin Ye said calmly, "I am only temporarily stabilizing your injury. Any movement will cause the sword energy to backfire and the cold poison to spread again."
When the woman heard this, her movements stopped, but her eyes remained cold and alert, like a female leopard ready to attack. She glanced at Qin Ye, then at A Luo next to her, and at this simple guest room. She seemed to be quickly recalling and judging the current situation.
"Did you...save me?" Her voice was very soft, weak and hoarse after being seriously injured, but the coldness and alienation in her tone remained unchanged.
"Passing by, please." Qin Ye said calmly, sat down at the table, poured himself a glass of water, and motioned for A Luo to sit down. "You killed several bandits from Black Wind Village at the entrance of the inn, and then fell to the ground with serious injuries. I helped you in and stabilized your injuries with acupuncture. That's all."
The woman was silent for a moment, as if she was feeling the situation inside her body. She could feel that the cold poison and violent sword energy that almost tore her apart had been temporarily suppressed and isolated by a gentle but tough force. Although the injury was still heavy, at least it no longer worsened, and there were even weak signs of repair. This made her cold and alert eyes flash with a trace of incredible surprise.
She knew her own injury well, it was caused by forcibly using the "Jinghong Yi Sword" to overdraw her heart, and the sinister power of the "Ice Palm" invaded her heart. For an injury like this, it would be difficult for ordinary doctors to even diagnose it, let alone treat it. And this young man who looked to be no more than seventeen or eighteen years old and whose cultivation seemed to be only at the first level of Body Tempering, could actually bring her back from hell in such a short period of time?
This is definitely not something ordinary doctors can do! Moreover, when he applied the acupuncture, the strange Qi that seeped into his body, although weak, carried an indescribable tenacity and... a palpitating characteristic that seemed to be able to reverse life and death!
"You... know medical skills? Who do you study under?" The woman looked at Qin Ye, the vigilance in her eyes had not completely dissipated, but her tone softened a little.
"I understand. As for the inheritance, I can't tell you." Qin Ye answered directly, looking at the woman, "Who are you? Why are you being chased by Black Wind Village? What's going on with the cold poison in your body and that high-grade sword energy?"
He didn't beat around the bush. After saving someone, you naturally have to figure out who you are saving and what trouble it will cause. This woman's origins were unknown, her strength was not weak (she was probably far beyond the Body Tempering Realm in her prime), and she was obviously in big trouble. He had to be aware of it.
The woman met Qin Ye's scrutinizing gaze and did not answer immediately. She was weighing. The young man in front of her saved her life, but his identity was mysterious and his strength was also strange. Whether they are enemies or friends is difficult to decide. But now that he was seriously injured and he was near the Black Wind Village's sphere of influence, it seemed that... he didn't have much choice.
For a moment, she seemed to have made up her mind and spoke slowly, her voice still cold: "My name is Ye Qingmei. I come from... Tianfeng County, Luoxia Sword Sect."
Tianfeng County? Luoxia Sword Sect?
Qin Ye searched in his memory. Qingyun City belongs to Tiannan County and is separated from Tianfeng County by thousands of miles, separated by large mountains and wilderness. He had a vague impression of the Luoxia Sword Sect. It seemed to be a sect famous for its swordsmanship. It was considered a leader among the second-rate forces in Tianfeng County, and seemed to be stronger than the Ziyang Sect. No wonder this woman's swordsmanship is so sharp and she can activate sword energy.
"As for being chased by Heifeng Village..." Ye Qingmei's eyes flashed with cold murderous intent and humiliation, "I was ordered by my master to go to the southwest of the 'Buried Sword Valley' to find the elixir 'Red Yang Zhuguo'. When passing through Heifeng Ridge , was ambushed by He Biao, the third master of Black Wind Village. They coveted my belongings and... the sword manual. I fought hard to break through and killed several people, but I was also injured by He Biao's "Ice Palm" and escaped all the way here. "
She paused and glanced at Qin Ye: "Those people at the door of the inn are scouts under He Biao. They just came back from plundering nearby villages and towns, and they happened to bump into them. I wanted to kill them and vent my hatred a little, but my injuries completely broke out."
That’s it. Qin Ye understood. As expected, Black Wind Village was so arrogant that they even dared to rob and kill the sect disciples who were passing by. He Biao's Ice Palm seemed to be the source of the cold poisonous power.
"What happened to the sword energy in your body backlashing?" Qin Ye asked. That sword energy was of a very high grade, probably not an ordinary inheritance from the Luoxia Sword Sect.
Ye Qingmei was silent for a moment, with a trace of complexity flashing in his eyes, but in the end he said calmly: "It was me who forcibly cast the sect's forbidden technique, 'Jinghong Yijian'. This sword is extremely powerful, but it comes at the cost of burning its source and overdrawing its potential. My cultivation is not enough, so I cast it forcefully, which caused the sword energy to get out of control and backfire, intertwined with the cold poison, and almost killed me."
title_en: Chapter 025: Frankly admitting all the requirements for trading Chapter 026: The Jinghong Sword Manual seduces the heart
